objective.text: Supply the production Vite manifest rather than assuming source entry paths are directly browser-loadable.

difficulty.rationale: Identify a missing build artifact instead of routing browsers to uncompiled source entries.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

assumptions: No development hot file exists. The application uses the default build directory and @vite("resources/js/app.js").

stem: Production throws ViteManifestNotFoundException. Which deployment correction addresses the normal production asset path?

options.text: Build and deploy the generated public/build assets and their manifest.
options.rationale: The Laravel Vite integration resolves production entry points through the build manifest and generated files.

options.text: Run only route:cache because the Vite manifest is a route lookup table.
options.rationale: The asset manifest is a separate build artifact, not Laravel’s route cache.
options.misconception: The asset manifest is a separate build artifact, not Laravel’s route cache.

options.text: Copy resources/js/app.js into a PHP controller and return its source.
options.rationale: That bypasses the bundler and does not provide the manifest expected by @vite.
options.misconception: That bypasses the bundler and does not provide the manifest expected by @vite.

options.text: Set APP_DEBUG=true so @vite compiles the JavaScript on each request.
options.rationale: Debug mode does not turn the PHP integration into a production JavaScript compiler.
options.misconception: Debug mode does not turn the PHP integration into a production JavaScript compiler.
